summary: Build a privacy-minimized FCC complaint aggregate
description: Fetch and validate the rolling official FCC unwanted-call dataset, normalize only US caller-ID values, aggregate neutral complaint categories, and store a keyed non-reversible lookup projection with provenance and freshness.
acceptance: The importer fetches a bounded rolling window from the manifest-declared Socrata endpoint, validates metadata/license/schema/freshness/pagination, normalizes only valid US caller-ID values, and fails closed without replacing a prior catalogue.

The generated immutable SQLite projection uses a deployment-secret HMAC lookup key and persists no plaintext phone-number inventory, raw complaint row, narrative, ticket ID, advertiser number, reporter location, ZIP code, or source response.

Per-number aggregates retain only bounded category counts, total observation count, first/last issue dates, source digest, generated time, window, and exact coverage statistics; generated databases and caches remain outside Git.
verification: uv run pytest tests/unit/test_fcc_catalog.py -q && make check
